dod_intent_evidence: SBIR/STTR record shows an Air Force Phase II award ($1,224,440, 2022) for CUTLASS, and the site's own testimonials cite testing with NGA, Naval Special Warfare, and a major prime contractor PM.
score_evidence: 'Shockingly Accurate... Based on F1 scores. 99% IR SINGLE CLASS' (repeated 3x) → lab_language_intensity

'Easily deploy on premise, on cloud, or at the federated tactical edge' — deployment mentioned only as a marketing checkbox, no DDIL/ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR specifics anywhere → deployment_awareness_absence
'Empower the modern warfighter to accurately and quickly operate with confidence' — the only operator reference is a tagline, no training/CONOPS/sustainment language → operator_absence
'Founded 2020... 20 employees... Capital Factory All Access Fund 2024' with SBIR Phase II already closed in 2022 and still describing itself as pre-program-of-record → stage_pressure

blind_spots.blind_spot: Claims 'federated tactical edge' deployment but the product's core value is multi-INT sensor fusion requiring continuous multichannel data streams
blind_spots.operator_reality: Same failure mode as the 30fps crowd-detection case — CUTLASS's 'combine near-simultaneous data streams... into a single multichannel tensor' architecture assumes sustained multi-sensor bandwidth that a DDIL environment will deny
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the SBIR abstract emphasizes model capability (accuracy, sensor-agnosticism) with no discussion of degraded-comms behavior
blind_spots.evidence_quote: CUTLASS utilizes state of the art multimodal machine learning models to combine near-simultaneous data streams of separate modalities into a single multichannel tensor

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Deploy on any UXS, ship, plane, or COP' with no SWaP-C discussion for constrained platforms
blind_spots.operator_reality: Running multichannel tensor fusion inference onboard a small UAS or USV has real compute/power ceilings; claiming universal platform deployment without addressing footprint means the E-5 finds out the hard way when it won't fit or drains batteries
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: pitch materials emphasize model performance (F1 scores, one-shot learning) over the hardware envelope it must run inside
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Cutlass is a software product that can deploy on any UXS, ship, plane, or COP to process sensor data in real-time from any sensor

blind_spots.blind_spot: Zero mention of ATO, RMF, STIG, IL4/IL5, or CMMC despite claiming integration into any government platform, new or old
blind_spots.operator_reality: A product this embedded in classified/sensitive ISR sensor chains cannot get on a government network without an ATO; absence of any compliance language at this stage of DoD testing is a live risk to the contract clock
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: team appears product/ML-focused (sensor fusion, neural networks per LinkedIn specialties) with no visible compliance or ISSO function
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Designed to work with any hardware, software or data, whether legacy systems, newly deployed systems, or the systems of the future

opener_hook: Modern Intelligence's CUTLASS won an AFRL SBIR Phase II in 2022 and has since been tested by NGA and Naval Special Warfare — worth asking how it performs when the tactical edge drops from continuous streams to intermittent comms.
what_they_do: CUTLASS is a sensor-agnostic AI platform that fuses EO/IR, SAR, acoustic, and RF sensor data across UAS, satellites, ships, and common operating picture platforms for maritime target detection and tracking.
